_doc: MAIN glyph grid (js/glyph/GlyphPreview.vue). Units = SVG slice units (ka slice = 540 tall); CSS scales them via --u (see --glyph-h in css/styles.css). Grid: columns = root | tsheg | shad (tsheg/shad columns only exist when shown); rows = vowelAbove | main | vowelBelow. All parts are separate SVG files; root cell is fixed rootW x rootH; cells use align-items:start so shad top == root crossbar top (root is pulled up by perGlyph.crossbarTop). debugTint:true paints vowel+shad in tintColor (cream).

perGlyph._doc: Optional per-wylie tweaks. crossbarTop: distance of crossbar top below slice top, in slice units (~47 for ka/kha/ga/nga). Root is shifted up by crossbarTop*scale so crossbar top = main row top. dx/dy nudge the root only.
